construction: 37 parts in 11 steps. Steps 2–5: brackets turn studs sideways (two 1×2–1×2 brackets in step 3). Step 8: bricks with studs on sides, hinge bases and four minifigure revolvers as exhaust pipes. Steps 9–11: hinge tops, a curved slope, handle plates and grille tiles.
lesson: Mechanical detail from sideways studs and repurposed parts: four minifigure revolvers become exhaust pipes.
parent_context: The engine under the bonnet of the Caterham (`21307 - Car.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Hang greebles on studs-on-sides bricks where no body panel is needed. Look for parts whose shape, not name, fits the role.
